description: Ranks 1 to 12 caller-described workflows by value, predictability, judgment, data sensitivity and integration complexity, and labels each automate, assist or discovery. Each workflow requires a name, weekly hours, predictability, judgment required, error cost, data sensitivity and system count. Returns each workflow's score, recommendation, human-review flag and rationale, plus a recommended first workflow and guardrails. It does not connect to or change any system.

items.description: One recurring workflow the user described. Ask for any field you lack.

dataSensitivity.description: How sensitive the data handled is.

errorCost.description: Cost of a mistake reaching a customer or record.

judgmentRequired.description: How much human judgment each case needs.

name.description: Workflow name, in the user's words.

predictability.description: How often the steps follow the same pattern.

systemsCount.description: Number of systems the workflow touches, 1 to 20.

weeklyHours.description: Total team hours per week spent on it, from the user.
